Privacy Terms

Bored Polymath Studios

Privacy Notice

Last updated November 6, 2026

MammoLingo is a general-education glossary operated by Bored Polymath Studios. It is designed so you can search and save glossary terms without creating an account or uploading a mammogram report.

Information handled on your device

Your search is performed in your browser. The app does not ask you to enter report text, health details, or account information; please do not enter them.

If you save a term, your browser stores the selected glossary item and the time it was saved in local browser storage. This list stays on that browser and device unless you clear it. The app also uses a service-worker cache so its glossary can be available offline after it has loaded.

Information we do not intentionally collect

MammoLingo does not provide accounts, report uploads, contact forms, analytics, advertising, profiling, marketing cookies, or error-reporting tools. We do not intentionally receive the searches you perform or the terms you save. If you voluntarily use the public GitHub issue tracker, the information you submit is handled by GitHub and is publicly visible; do not include report text, symptoms, personal details, or other health information.

Connection information

Like most websites, the hosting provider may process technical connection information, such as an IP address, browser type, device information, request time, and pages requested, to deliver and secure the site. Bored Polymath Studios does not configure this app to use that information for advertising, profiling, or health-related tracking.

External links

Source links open third-party websites. Their privacy practices apply once you leave MammoLingo; review their notices before providing information to them.

Your choices

Use Clear all on the Saved screen to remove saved terms, or use your browser settings to clear this site’s storage and cache. Clearing browser data may remove saved terms and offline content.

Children

MammoLingo is not designed to collect personal information from children. Do not use it to submit personal, health, or report information about yourself or anyone else.

Updates and contact

We may update this notice as the app changes and will revise the date above. For public feedback about the app, links, accessibility, or content, use the GitHub issue tracker. It is public: do not include report text, symptoms, personal details, or other health information. This notice does not limit rights you may have under applicable law.

Educational content; not medical advice
